researchCheckpoint.warning: Official regulated market page showed 116 entries on 2026-11-10 while September snapshot contains 133 across segments. Counts are not directly comparable. No definitive company eligibility or delisting conclusion without issuer-by-issuer evidence.
researchCheckpoint.nextRequired: Review all 133 issuer identities, legal status, trading status, primary venue, security type against current official records.

currentOfficialSnapshot.verification: Official page shows 131 listings on 2026-11-13; identity of two differences not yet verified. Do not remove candidates based on aggregate counts.

researchCheckpoint.methodologyCorrection: Do not equate a 2026 trading suspension with permanent delisting, nor a Belgian company domicile with Brussels primary listing. Do not equate an Euronext multi-market venue string with primary venue.

companyOnlyPolicy: Include only actively operating companies and genuine listed holding/REIT entities with Brussels as primary listing. Exclude certificates, ETFs, funds without qualifying corporate issuer, shells, defunct issuers, and foreign-primary cross listings. No definitive inclusion from a name alone.
